high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a text-based article or excerpt from a digital document. The content discusses the behavior of social insects, specifically ants, in caring for sick individuals within their colonies. The text explains that ants have specialized individuals who care for the sick by grooming them to remove external parasites and applying antimicrobial poisons onto their bodies. The article then poses a question about whether these caregivers are at a greater risk of catching the infection and spreading it to the rest of the healthy colony.
